title: Letterhead
slide_intent: Teach how first and continuation pages carry different amounts of identity. A reader needs a clear sender on arrival and an unobstructed text area as the letter continues.
strategic_value: CSAIL can offer individual senders a choice of templates while keeping multi-page correspondence visibly related.
demonstration: Two overlapping page pairs compare a generic and a personalized first page with continuation pages. The lower samples distinguish horizontal footer and vertical edge treatments.
practical_value: Choose a first-page variant and its continuation treatment by comparing sender detail, text margins and accent placement.

content_islands.name: Template key
content_islands.spec: Explain the left and right pairs in the narrow text column.

content_islands.name: Generic pair
content_islands.spec: Overlap a generic first page with a continuation beneath it; keep the colored horizontal accent at the foot.

content_islands.name: Personalized pair
content_islands.spec: Show a filled first-page example and continuation with a vertical accent; retain a clear body-text margin.
